extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '24011010') and 6-digit subheading codes without dots (e.g., '240110'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN (e.g., '2401.10.10') and NNNN.NN (e.g., '2401.10') per project schema. 4-digit headings (e.g., '2401') left as-is.

PDF tariff line code '24022050' description is split across two table rows: 'Filter cigarettes of length (including the length of the filter, the length of filter being 11 millimetres or its actual length, whichever is more) exceeding 75 millimetres but not' continues on next row as 'exceeding 85 millimetres'. Recombined verbatim as a single description.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification No Notification Date', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Sub-Heading Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

The Section IV Main Note about 'pellets' appears on PDF page 1 above the Chapter 24 title. This is the standard Section IV note (Section IV covers prepared foodstuffs, beverages, spirits, vinegar, tobacco, and nicotine products) and is attributed to section_notes.
The Notification Date and Notification No columns are EMPTY for all rows in the Main Notes and Sub-Heading Notes tables of this chapter. Captured as null.
All tariff lines in the chapter show Export Policy 'Free' with EMPTY Policy Condition column. No policy_conditions or export_licensing_notes apply to this chapter — both arrays are present but empty.

Subheading 2403.11 description in PDF reads 'Smoking tobacco, whether or not containing tobacco substitutes in any proporation -- Water pipe tobacco specified in Subheading Note 1 to this chapter' — note the PDF typo 'proporation' (instead of 'proportion'); preserved verbatim. Same typo appears for subheading 2403.19.

Subheading 2403.91 in PDF is represented as the single 8-digit tariff line '24039100' ('Other : -- Homogenised or reconstituted tobacco') with no separate subheading row in the source — the subheading-level entry is implied. Encoded as subheading '2403.91' with one tariff line '2403.91.00'.

Heading 2404 title in PDF is rendered in ALL CAPS ('PRODUCTS CONTAINING TOBACCO, RECONSTITUTED TOBACCO, NICOTINE, OR TOBACCO OR NICOTINE SUBSTITUTES, INTENDED FOR INHALATION WITHOUT COMBUSTION; OTHER NICOTINE CONTAINING PRODUCTS INTENDED FOR THE INTAKE OF NICOTINE INTO THE HUMAN BODY') unlike other headings in this chapter. Preserved verbatim in uppercase as in the source.

Heading 2404 has no separate subheading rows in the PDF (only 6 tariff lines: 24041100, 24041200, 24041900, 24049100, 24049200, 24049900). Encoded as four subheadings (2404.11, 2404.12, 2404.19, 2404.91, 2404.92, 2404.99) each with a single tariff line at the .00 suffix, inferred from the 8-digit code structure.

Heading 2403 has 8-digit codes '24031921' ('Biris:---- Other than paper rolled biris, manufactured without the aid of machine') and '24031929' ('Biris:---- Other') which both belong to subheading 2403.19. Grouped under subheading 2403.19 along with 24031910 and 24031990.
Tariff line code '24013000' (Tobacco refuse) is encoded as subheading '2401.30' with single tariff line '2401.30.00' since the source PDF lacks a separate 6-digit subheading row for 240130.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover medicinal cigarettes (Chapter 30).
Any products classifiable in heading 2404 and any other heading of the Chapter are to be classified in heading 2404.
For the purposes of heading 2404, the expression "inhalation without combustion" means inhalation through heated delivery or other means, without combustion.

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.

chapter_subheading_notes.text: For the purposes of sub-heading 2403 11, the expression "water pipe tobacco" means tobacco intended for smoking in a water pipe and which consists of a mixture of tobacco and glycerol, whether or not contain-ing aromatic oils and extracts, molasses or sugar, and whether or not flavoured with fruit. However, tobacco-free products intended for smoking in a water pipe are excluded from this sub-heading.
